name: mangoo
description: Windows-first local media browser indexing existing folders.

scripts.check:core-client: npm --workspace @mangoo/core-client run check && npm --workspace @mangoo/core-client run typecheck && npm --workspace @mangoo/core-client run test
scripts.check:notification-contract: npm --workspace @mangoo/notification-contract run check && npm --workspace @mangoo/notification-contract run typecheck && npm --workspace @mangoo/notification-contract run test
scripts.check:desktop: node --test tools/dev/web-dev-url.test.mjs && node tools/checks/validate-desktop-core.mjs && npm --workspace @mangoo/desktop run typecheck && npm --workspace @mangoo/desktop run test
scripts.build:desktop-package: node tools/build/build-bundled-plugins.mjs --release-profile && cargo build --release -p mangoo-core && npm --workspace @mangoo/web run build && npm --workspace @mangoo/desktop run build && node tools/build/package-desktop.mjs
scripts.check:web: node tools/checks/validate-web-client.mjs && npm --workspace @mangoo/web run typecheck && npm --workspace @mangoo/web run test
scripts.check:plugin-sdk: npm --workspace @mangoo/plugin-sdk run build && npm --workspace @mangoo/plugin-sdk run test
scripts.test: npm run check:structure && npm run check:plugin-artifacts && npm run check:plugin-sdk && npm run check:plugin-image-viewer && npm run check:core-api && npm run check:core-client && npm run check:notification-contract && npm run check:desktop && npm run check:web && npm run check:ui-design && npm run check:schema && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:plugin-image-viewer: npm --workspace @mangoo/plugin-image-viewer run typecheck && npm --workspace @mangoo/plugin-image-viewer run test
